title: Auditable Pricing Pipeline with MRO Guard Rails
instructions: Implement `Quote`-producing mixins, `build_pricer` and `pricing_order` in `pricing.py`. Each mixin calls `super().quote(km)`, adjusts the amount and appends its own class-qualified step name so the audit trail is correct whatever the leftmost class is. `build_pricer` must reject invalid or duplicate mixins with `TypeError`, and `pricing_order` must report the application order from the MRO.

evidence.label: Mixin order decides application order, and the audit trail matches
Three mixins compose and each appends its own step name
pricing_order matches the MRO, innermost first
pricing_order does not count inherited step names twice
Quote is a frozen dataclass with a tuple of steps
build_pricer rejects BaseFare subclasses, non-classes and objects without step_name
build_pricer returns a fresh BaseFare subclass each call
Unknown or missing keyword arguments raise TypeError
